description: Input-only credentials. Serde's `skip_serializing` also emits JSON Schema `writeOnly`, so a request can be accepted but cannot become an echo DTO.

save_credentials.description: Task 72 (design C1): the user ticked "save the password on this machine". The server seals it (AES-256-GCM, write-only) and keeps collecting with it.
